category_edits.rationale: Jointly shorten MAXLEN to 64 and increase batch size to 256 across all four categories. Shorter sequences reduce attention cost, while larger batches supply more masked targets per update. Retain learning rate 7e-4 and dropout 0.1. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction propagate MAXLEN consistently. Preserve the BERT4Rec backbone, features, embedding tying, readout, loss, optimizer, seeds and training limits.

change_summary: Set shared BERT4Rec defaults to MAXLEN=64 and batch size=256; existing metadata keeps checkpoint and predictor shapes consistent.
